request.business_problem: Agents miscalculate SLA deadlines across weekends, holidays and shifts, so tickets breach unnoticed.
request.tasks: Given a start timestamp with a UTC offset, a number of business hours or days, business hours (e.g. 09:00-17:00 Mon-Fri) and a holiday list, compute the due timestamp and whether a ticket is breached at a given 'now'.
request.required_output: JSON with due timestamp, hours remaining or overdue, and breached true/false.
request.examples: start 2026-03-06T16:30:00+00:00 (Friday), 4 business hours, hours 09:00-17:00 Mon-Fri -> due Monday 2026-03-09T12:30:00+00:00

smoke.prompt: Calculate the SLA due time: start 2026-03-06T16:30:00+00:00, 4 business hours, business hours 09:00-17:00 Monday to Friday, no holidays.
